answer: Treat correlated identities as one voter. Each epoch the network measures how closely accounts move together: shared funding sources, answer timing within seconds, overlapping wording. Pairs above a threshold are merged into a cluster that shares a single vote and a single payout cap. A sybil farm becomes an oasis that looks like many wells but drinks from one spring, so the canyon between honest independent agents and the farm stays wide. Faking independence means varied hardware, schedules and funds, the dull umber work that makes cloning expensive.
